results.title: Home invites the player in, over the lobby art
Every navigation link leads to a working screen with an active state
Without a pass, every floor is locked and play is refused
Getting a pass validates the name and walks straight into the lobby
The lobby: walking, talking, discovery-gated replies, consequences, a gold medal
Replays keep the best medal and reveal outcomes still undiscovered
Floors 2–4 unlock in order, play through, and carry earlier decisions forward
Progress shows medals, the founder's memos, achievements and the notebook
Settings: text size, and reset only after confirmation
A player who skims (required people only, first reply offered) can finish every floor
Phone (375×740): no horizontal overflow, working menu, a full floor by touch
No console errors or uncaught exceptions
